title: TRICARE Select Coverage Within a TRICARE Prime First Installment
content:
Months that the first installment of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment owes may overlap the beneficiary's TRICARE Select enrollment.

TRICARE Select coverage is read from the beneficiary's TRICARE Select enrollment: a month lies wholly inside it when it falls after the month containing the Select effective date and before the month containing the Select disenrollment date, or, where the Select enrollment has no disenrollment date, when it falls after the month containing the Select effective date; a month is touched by it when it contains the Select effective date or the Select disenrollment date.

| For a month the first installment owes | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Select coverage holds the month wholly | that month is left out - its monthly rate comes off |
| Select coverage only touches the month | the month is billed less Select's monthly share |
| otherwise | the month is billed in full |

What TRICARE Select's coverage takes off - the months left out at the monthly rate plus the touched months at Select's monthly share, rounded to the cent - comes off the first installment.

## Worked months (hypothetical)

The first installment owes April, May and June at a monthly rate of 40.39; the TRICARE Select enrollment was effective 1 January and disenrolled 15 May; Select's monthly share is 30.00.

- April falls after January and before May: wholly inside, 40.39 comes off.
- May contains the disenrollment date: touched, 30.00 comes off.
- June: billed in full.

Taken off: 70.39. With a TRICARE Select enrollment effective 10 April and no disenrollment date, April is touched and May and June lie wholly inside: 30.00 plus 2 times 40.39, 110.78 taken off.
